lines.text: One, two, three, let's go! Neon lights, jump high, jump low!
Mochi Cat is in the house! Meow!
Left foot, right foot, run, run, run! Healthy energy, lots of fun!
See the laser, green and blue, Mochi Cat is here with you!
One, two, don't stop now, jump so high and show me how!
Pizza? No! Burger? No! We love sports, let's make a show!
Get ready, get steady… Three! Two! One! GO!
NEON JUMP! Hop, hop! Up to the sky, we never stop!
NEON JUMP! Bounce, bounce! We are moving, every ounce!
Left, right, up and down, coolest cats in the town! NEON JUMP!
Cyber track, cyber pace, we are running in the space!
Eat clean, feel great, no more food upon my plate!
One, two, three, four, dance and jump upon the floor!
Are you ready? Yes! Can you feel the speed? Yes!
Faster… Faster… Faster… RUN! RUN! RUN!
Jump! Jump! Neon Jump! Bounce! Bounce! Neon Bounce!
Jump! Jump! Neon Jump! Bounce! Bounce! Neon Bounce!
Mochi Cat! Super Cat! Three, two, one… FREEZE! Meow!
